scope: MuJoCo against closed forms: a spring-mass natural frequency, the two modes of a two-mass chain, a preloaded follower on a simple-harmonic cam (lift and contact force) and its float speed. A witness of the tool with round witness inputs, not a run of the head; docs/TOOLCHAIN.md assigns the tool on it

tool.name: MuJoCo
tool.environment: private venv built with uv from the lock (--require-hashes); never committed

acceptance.float_detector: contact never lost at 0.9 of the closed-form float speed; contact lost and the follower more than 0.01 mm off the cam at 1.1

contact.why: MuJoCo contacts are soft constraints. A time constant of 5e-5 s puts the contact's own frequency (about 1/5e-5 = 20,000 rad/s) some 30 times above the fastest cam speed of the force cases (0.9 x 693 rad/s), so the contact should add about (623 x 5e-5)^2 = 0.1% to the follower force; the constant impedance 0.99 makes the contact nearly hard

settings.cam_drive: the cam body carries 1000 kg m2 about its hinge and starts at the case speed: no motor; the drift of its speed is recorded
settings.spring: joint stiffness on the follower's slide joint, spring reference at -preload/rate, so the spring pushes the follower onto the cam with the preload at zero lift
settings.evaluated: the last full cam cycle for force and lift; the last two for the float detector

witness_inputs.status: witness input: round numbers chosen so that the closed forms are easy to check by hand. Not a value of the 935 head, of its valve train or of any engine
witness_inputs.cam: eccentric circle under a flat-faced follower, radial, no lash, no friction, no gravity: lift = e (1 - cos theta), simple harmonic

two_mass_chain.layout: ground - k1 - m1 - k2 - m2, both on one axis

cases.case: cam follower at 0.5 of the float speed
cam follower at 0.9 of the float speed

cases.detector: contact force zero or no contact at any step of the last two cycles

controls.control: natural frequency with the model's mass 10% above the declared mass
cam case at 0.9 of the float speed with the spring preload left out of the model
cam case at 0.9 of the float speed with MuJoCo's default contact (solref 0.02 s 1, solimp 0.9 0.95 0.001 0.5 2)

checks.check: natural frequency within the declared relative error
two-mass mode 1: frequency within the declared relative error
two-mass mode 1: stays in its shape
two-mass mode 2: frequency within the declared relative error
two-mass mode 2: stays in its shape
cam at 0.5: follower lift within the declared share of the full lift
cam at 0.5: contact force within the declared share of the peak force
cam at 0.9: follower lift within the declared share of the full lift
cam at 0.9: contact force within the declared share of the peak force
float detector: contact kept at 0.9 of the float speed
float detector: contact lost and the follower more than 0.01 mm off the cam at 1.1
float speed: the declared bracket holds the tool's float speed
control: natural frequency with the model's mass 10% above the declared mass: caught
control: cam case at 0.9 of the float speed with the spring preload left out of the model: caught
control: cam case at 0.9 of the float speed with MuJoCo's default contact (solref 0.02 s 1, solimp 0.9 0.95 0.001 0.5 2): caught
